ideas.name: Large unlock pre-event weakness
ideas.claim: Tokens with unlocks of at least 10.4% of circulating supply weakened against Bitcoin in the week before the unlock.
ideas.quote: Strong unlocks (≥ 10.4% of circulating) are weaker than Bitcoin in the week before — Works
ideas.mechanism: Anticipated token supply release and selling pressure

rules.filters: Unlock size at least 10.4% of circulating supply

ideas.claimed_result: 78 of 100 events fell against Bitcoin, with an average relative move of -7.3%; the site reports 2023–2026 data.
required_data: Historical token unlock dates and sizes

ideas.name: Unlocks exceeding daily trading volume
ideas.claim: For unlocks worth at least one average day's trading volume, the median coin move over the following 30 days was negative.
ideas.quote: The middle case of 114 since 2024 saw a coin move −5.8% in the 30 days after a token unlock worth a day or more of trading.
ideas.mechanism: Token supply release relative to trading volume

rules.timeframe: From the close before the unlock day to the close 30 days after it
rules.filters: Scheduled unlock value at least equal to average daily dollar volume over the preceding 30 days

ideas.claimed_result: Median move -5.8% across 114 cases from June 2024 through September 2026; the source reports no clear edge against ordinary days.
required_data: Historical token unlock dates and sizes
